AA83

- Growing from soil, beneath wooldnad duff in upland, mixed oak/hickory woodland edge.
- Smell: farinaceous (watermelon rind).
- Taste: farinaceous (watermelon rind).
- Microscopy: Mounted in Melzer's Reagent. Spores polyhedral.
